title: Calm, Clear Mind
author: Tara Kadampa Meditation Centre, Dublin
description: This podcast is a place for conversations on how we can all keep a calm, clear mind in a hectic and at times chaotic world, and discover our potential to live with deeper inner peace and happiness in everyday life. We explore how meditation and Buddha’s timeless advice - as explained in modern Kadampa Buddhism - can help everyone (Buddhist and non-Buddhist alike) work through the challenges we meet in daily life with greater clarity, ease and compassion, and in a way that’s easy to understand and apply to everyday life.

episodes_recents.titre: Finding Inner Peace, In Difficult Times
Restore balance, find inner peace & joy in life
